source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    wall = grid[0][next((j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))), 0)]
    rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(value == row[0] for value in row)]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == grid[0][j] for i in range(h))]
    # The full-width/full-height divider color is the one shared by separator lines.
    wall_candidates = [grid[i][j] for i in rows for j in range(w)]
    wall = Counter(wall_candidates).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [i for i in range(h) if all(v == wall for v in grid[i])]
    cols = [j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j] == wall for i in range(h))]
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != wall).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rbounds, cbounds = [-1] + rows + [h], [-1] + cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(rbounds)-1):
        line=[]
        for ci in range(len(cbounds)-1):
            r0,r1=rbounds[ri]+1,rbounds[ri+1]
            c0,c1=cbounds[ci]+1,cbounds[ci+1]
            count=sum(grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != wall for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            line.append(1 if count > 1 else bg)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
